name: TitanRL environment: torchtitan v0.4.0 and the nightlies its RL installer pins together

tasks.name: a separate checkout so the RL nightlies never touch the checkpoint investigation's venv
scripts/install_rl_env.sh (torch, torchvision and vLLM nightlies from one index, FA3 on Hopper)
commands: command -v uv || (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh)

DRV=$(nvidia-smi | grep -oE 'CUDA Version: [0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$'); case $DRV in 13.[2-9]*|1[4-9]*) CU=cu132;; 13.*) CU=cu130;; *) CU=cu128;; esac; echo "driver-cuda=$DRV wheel=$CU" | tee $OUT/cuda-tag.txt
cd $RL_SRC && VIRTUAL_ENV=$VENV PATH=$VENV/bin:$PATH bash scripts/install_rl_env.sh --cuda $CU 2>&1 | tail -60 | tee $OUT/install.txt
$VENV/bin/python -c 'import torch, vllm; print("torch", torch.__version__, "cuda", torch.version.cuda, "vllm", vllm.__version__)' | tee $OUT/imports.txt

tasks.name: bi_on and bi_off resolve (print the config, no GPUs used)
commands: cd $RL_SRC && for R in bi_on bi_off; do PYTHONPATH=$RL_SRC:$INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts $VENV/bin/python -m torchtitan.rl.train --module bi_recipes --config $R --print-config > $OUT/print-config-$R.txt 2>&1 || { tail -30 $OUT/print-config-$R.txt; exit 1; }; grep -E 'batch_invariant|num_training_steps|enable_wandb' $OUT/print-config-$R.txt | head -6; done
